# Communication, Persuasion & Taste

This is the domain map for speaking, writing, persuasion, brand, taste, teaching, campaign logic, and idea transfer.

## Why this matters

Communication is a practical force multiplier across work, venture, leadership, public policy, and personal learning. The useful material in this domain should become reusable models, not just notes about individual speeches or marketing sources.

## Current map

| Page | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [Communication & Idea Transfer](/wiki/communication-and-idea-transfer) | Speaking, slide discipline, pacing, contribution-focused endings, and teaching. |
| [Persuasion & Demand Creation](/wiki/persuasion-and-demand-creation) | Brand promises, contrast, trust, permission, hospitality, and demand. |
| [Venture Opportunity Discovery](/wiki/venture-opportunity-discovery) | Demand testing and audience signal where communication meets market selection. |
| [AI-Assisted Content Systems](/wiki/ai-assisted-content-systems) | Capture, drafting, voice conditioning, content operations, and feedback loops. |

## Practical questions

- What makes an idea move from information to transfer?
- Which persuasion models are durable enough to reuse?
- What writing and speaking patterns fit the user's voice and goals?
- Which content systems create useful learning rather than volume?
